groups.name: host
groups.why: the upstream USB-A PCB plug (declared pose) with its D-/D+ TVS diodes right behind its pins (B side); the hub's UP_D pins are on U1's +x side

groups.name: power
groups.why: power entry: JP1 (EXTPWR) bridges the plug's VBUS to VIN, J9 the external ground pad beside it; U2 (SLG5NT1487V load switch) VIN -> +5V with its VIN cap C21, its slew-rate cap C28 on CAP, the VIN TVS D24 and the switched-rail TVS D25

groups.name: core
groups.why: the XR22417 7-port hub, its 12 MHz crystal on XTALIN/XTALOUT, its VCC5 cap C1, the +3.3V (C3, C5-C10) and +1V8 (C4, C11-C13) decaps of its internal regulators, the EXT_RST#/TEST1#/TEST3# 100k pull-ups R3-R5, the REXT resistor R6 and the VBUS_SENSE divider R1/R2 with C2 at pin 41

groups.name: bulk5v
groups.why: the switched +5V rail's distributed bulk and decoupling: seven 0.1uF 100V 0805s on F and fifteen 22uF 0603s on B. The rail feeds U1's VCC5 and all seven downstream VBUS pins; the decap rule tethers them to U1 (its only +5V supply pin), so they ring the hub

groups.name: bulk_edge
groups.why: the 330uF electrolytic, drawn as a board-edge part (Board_Edge_Mirrored: its 6.3x11 mm can lies past local y=0, outside its courtyard), so it is seated on the north edge by intent_run.json's edge_connectors row with its can off the board

groups.name: leds
groups.why: the seven per-port status duo-LEDs (F) with their 470R series resistors (B), one unit each, LED1-LED7 from U1 and the shared LED_CTL line; status LEDs go as a row toward an edge, and the only free top-side area besides the strip between the connector columns is the north end

groups.name: p1
groups.why: downstream port 1 (JST-SH, declared pose) with its D-/D+ TVS diodes at its pins
